notes.title: Small update 1.1.2 bug fix and more
notes.content:
NEW UPDATE

By users request we have changed running button. Now you have to press left hand trigger and swing arms for running. Hope it will be more comfortable :)

Also, we have configured our running speed and we have made the monster slower.

Fixed some small bugs. 

Stay tuned for more features.

Hope you will enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Update 1.1 New game mode added
notes.content:
Nightmare mode 

We added new mode - Nightmare. In this mode you only have a flashlight on your head. In this game mode you will also find new obstacles and new enemies to shoot. Here you have to be very observant, because you can only see very little in front of you. 

http://i.imgur.com/kmc2Gg8.png

 New gun mechanics 

Now you don't need to pick up a weapon at the start of the game. The gun will be in your hand. You just need to reload the weapon with touchpad in order to shoot. This saves some time for you to run further from the monster.

 More 


    New obstacles
    New enemies
    Updated menu scene
    Adjusted monster speed
    Minor bug fixes
